title: SpireBench：用《杀戮尖塔》评估智能体模型的长时程策略博弈
summary: SpireBench 让 20 个大语言模型在最高难度下完整游玩商业卡牌构筑游戏《杀戮尖塔》，评估其长时程策略推理能力。前沿模型超越启发式基线并达到人类平均水平，但远逊于专家，且随游戏进程拉长差距扩大。模型普遍误判风险、过度保守，且无法从跨局记忆中改进。该基准可定位智能体失败的位置与原因。
summary_en: SpireBench evaluates 20 LLMs playing the full commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire at highest difficulty. Frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match average humans but lag far behind experts, with the gap widening as runs lengthen. Models misjudge risk, play overly cautiously, and fail to improve from cross-run memories. It offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark to locate where and why agents fail.
